preconditions.description: The input must contain two integers n (number of silos) and k (number of scout groups) where 2 ≤ n ≤ 2000 and 1 ≤ k ≤ n - 1.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.split()) == 2 and all(line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: The input must have exactly n-1 lines after the first line, each containing n-i integers (where i is the line index starting from 1), representing the number of droids between silos i and j (i < j).

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= int(num) <= 10**9 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for num in line.split())
preconditions.description: Each c_{i,j} must satisfy -1 ≤ c_{i,j} ≤ 10^9, where -1 indicates no passage between silos i and j.

preconditions.expression: all(c_i_j == c_j_i for i in range(1, n) for j in range(i+1, n+1) if (c_i_j := int(stdin.splitlines()[i-1].split()[j-i-1])) != -1)
preconditions.description: The passages are bidirectional, so c_{i,j} = c_{j,i} for all existing passages (c_{i,j} != -1).

preconditions.expression: n >= 2 and k >= 1 and k <= n - 1
preconditions.description: The polygon must have at least 2 silos, and k must be at least 1 and at most n-1.

postconditions.description: The output must be a non-negative integer representing the average danger of the scouting operation, rounded down to the nearest integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(num) <= 10**9 for num in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: The input matrix c_{i,j} is parsed correctly, with -1 indicating no passage.

postconditions.expression:
n_choose_k := lambda n, k: math.comb(n, k) if k <= n else 0
S = set(range(1, n+1))
valid_S = [S_comb for S_comb in combinations(S, k)]
sum_danger := sum(sum(c_i_j for i in S_comb for j in [adjacent_S] if c_i_j != -1) for S_comb in valid_S)
average_danger := sum_danger // len(valid_S) if valid_S else 0
stdout.strip() == str(average_danger)
postconditions.description: For every possible k-element set S of silos, there exists exactly one silo adjacent to all silos in S. The danger for each S is the sum of droids on passages from each silo in S to the adjacent silo. The output is the floor of the average danger across all valid S.

postconditions.expression:
adjacent_S := lambda S: next(silo for silo in range(1, n+1) if all(c_i_j != -1 for i in S for j in [silo] if i != j)) if S else None
all(adjacent_S(S_comb) is not None for S_comb in combinations(range(1, n+1), k))
postconditions.description: For every k-element set S, there exists exactly one silo adjacent to all silos in S (i.e., connected to each silo in S by a passage).
